text: 6. In the Roman Republic, those seeking high office would bleach their heavy wool togas with chalk to achieve a brilliant, dazzling white that symbolized purity and visibility. This specific garment, known as the Toga ________, provided the linguistic root for the modern term applied to anyone running for a political position. The whiteness was a marketing tool, intended to make the seeker stand out in a crowded forum. What is the modern English word derived from this chalk-whitened garment?

7. The statutes governing the world’s most prestigious intellectual prize generally forbid the honoring of those who have already shuffled off this mortal coil. However, a bureaucratic oversight in 2011 led to the announcement of Ralph Steinman as a laureate for his discovery of the dendritic cell, only for the committee to discover he had passed away three days prior. Rather than rescind the honor, the committee made a historic exception to their rigid "living only" policy. What is the name of this specific international award?
